activities.before: Senior baccalaureate nursing students preparing for a primary care telehealth practicum complete a self-paced orientation before they speak with live patients by phone. As part of it, each student holds at least two telehealth conversations in which a chatbot is asked to role-play a patient, choosing from faculty-written scenarios (a medication refill request, a question about advance directives, a parent managing a child's asthma) or writing their own. The student conducts the call as the nurse, triaging, assessing and teaching, then checks the information exchanged for accuracy and uploads the transcripts. Alongside the chatbot calls, students complete commercial telehealth simulations that return motivational-interviewing feedback and write a reflection on that feedback. Faculty then observe students during the live practicum with clinic nurses. The products are the conversation transcripts and a motivational-interviewing reflection.
activities.after: Senior baccalaureate nursing students preparing for a primary care telehealth practicum complete a self-paced orientation before they speak with live patients by phone. As part of it, each student holds at least two telehealth conversations in which a chatbot is asked to role-play a patient, choosing from faculty-written scenarios (a medication refill request, a question about advance directives, a parent managing a child's asthma) or writing their own. The student conducts the call as the nurse, triaging, assessing and teaching, then checks the information exchanged for accuracy and uploads the transcripts. This activity covers the chatbot role-play and the checked conversation transcripts. In the source study, the broader orientation also included commercial telehealth simulations with motivational-interviewing feedback and a reflection, followed by faculty observation during a live practicum with clinic nurses. Those commercial simulations and the practicum are context for the study, not requirements of this free chatbot activity.
activities.reason: Align the summary with the supplied adaptation note, which explicitly narrows the activity to the free chatbot role-play. Preserve the full-study context and its evidence boundary.
